text: 都不用卖淫合法化，当年东莞半合法化，都没人结婚。
en: Even without legalising prostitution, back when Dongguan had semi-legalised it, nobody got married.

text: 一个月1万，除去房租生活费，每周开车或者坐和谐号去几趟东莞，一个月下来还有得剩。
en: With 10,000 yuan a month, after deducting rent and living costs, driving or taking the Harmony train to Dongguan a few times a week, you would still have some left over by the end of the month.

text: 脑子进水了的才结婚。
en: Only someone with water on the brain would get married.

text: 合法化的结果就是低结婚率，少子化，年轻人躺平，消费降级。
en: The result of legalisation is a low marriage rate, a falling birth rate, young people lying flat, and consumption downgrading.

text: 2345线城市房价崩盘。
en: House prices in second-, third-, fourth- and fifth-tier cities collapse.

text: 性是跟吃喝睡觉一样的基本生理需求，性专营是反人类行为
en: Sex is a basic physiological need on a par with eating, drinking and sleeping; the monopolisation of sex is an act against humanity.

text: 女人有自己身体做主的权利。
en: Women have the right to make decisions about their own bodies.

text: 你反驳吧。
en: You rebut it, then.

text: 卖淫应该不应该合法化不是道德问题，是一个社会共识问题，也就是取决于社会共识程度是什么样的，但不是道德问题。
en: Whether prostitution should be legalised is not a moral question but a matter of social consensus — that is, it depends on the degree of social consensus, but it is not a moral question.

text: 今天中国社会的共识还是不能接受合法化，那么不合法就有其合理性的。
en: Today the consensus in Chinese society still cannot accept legalisation, so its being illegal has its own rationale.

text: 作为中年人，我自己对很多社会问题其实立场很宽泛，可以接受大多数人的共识，哪怕这个共识日后移动，我也可以接受移动。
en: As a middle-aged person, my own stance on many social issues is actually quite broad; I can accept the consensus of the majority, and even if that consensus shifts later on, I can accept the shift.

text: 所以你要反对卖淫合法化，就一句：中国社会目前还没有开放到接受这个的程度。
en: So if you want to oppose the legalisation of prostitution, just say one thing: Chinese society has not yet opened up to the point of accepting this.

text: 其实这理由足够了。
en: Actually, that reason is sufficient.

text: 你甚至还可以加一句：太平洋没有加盖:)
en: You could even add a line: the Pacific Ocean has no lid :)

text: 同时我特别讨厌有些人以为自己不支持卖淫合法就是道德水平更高。
en: At the same time, I particularly dislike how some people think that not supporting the legalisation of prostitution means they have a higher moral standard.

text: 举个例子，这些人对卖淫合法化的经典质问是：你希望你的孩子/伴侣去卖淫吗？
en: For example, the classic challenge these people put to the legalisation of prostitution is: do you want your child or spouse to go into prostitution?

text: 对上面这个提问的回答其实有个最简单的类比逻辑：你希望你儿子/女儿以后是lgbt吗？
en: The answer to the question above actually has the simplest analogy: do you want your son or daughter to be LGBT in the future?

text: 希望有一天他们和你说他想换个性别吗？
en: Do you want them one day to tell you they want to change their gender?

text: 就像马斯克家的老大一样？
en: Just like the eldest child of the Musk family?

text: 所以呢？
en: So what?

text: 就因为社会上大多数人肯定不希望（甚至我认识很多lgbt自己做了父母以后也不希望），所以就要规定lgbt犯法吗？
en: Just because most people in society surely do not want that (I even know many LGBT people who, after becoming parents themselves, do not want it either), should we then make being LGBT illegal?

text: 所以宽容lgbt就不道德了？
en: So is tolerating LGBT immoral?

text: 卖淫可能引起的社会问题，是政府治理水平问题（制定以及执行合规能力的问题）。
en: The social problems prostitution might cause are a matter of the government's governance capacity (the ability to formulate and enforce compliance).

text: 所有认为只要合法了就会群魔乱舞的基本上都属于对政府能力和官员操守的恶毒想象。
en: All those who believe that legalisation would lead to total chaos basically harbour a malicious imagining of the government's capability and officials' integrity.

text: 公认来说赌博引起的社会危害可是大于卖淫的，澳门治理的很差吗？
en: By common acknowledgement, the social harm caused by gambling is greater than that caused by prostitution, yet is Macau poorly governed?

text: 干嘛不呼吁澳门禁赌呢？
en: Why not call for a ban on gambling in Macau?

text: 就因为你们不敢反对一国两制？
en: Is it simply because you dare not oppose 'one country, two systems'?

text: 激烈反对合法化的一般是女性，反正我从来没看到男性要反对男性卖淫的。
en: Those who fiercely oppose legalisation are generally women; in any case, I have never seen a man oppose male prostitution.

text: 男性卖淫对男性立场的社会伤害（如果有的话）和女性卖淫对女性的社会伤害应该是一样的吧？
en: The social harm of male prostitution to men (if any) should be the same as the social harm of female prostitution to women, shouldn't it?

text: 抛开对社会共识的认可，我自己本身也是反对大陆卖淫合法化，不过和道德无关。
en: Setting aside recognition of social consensus, I myself also oppose the legalisation of prostitution on the mainland, though it has nothing to do with morality.

text: 中国社会目前其实是3个阶层：上层男性，女性和男性。
en: Chinese society today actually consists of three strata: top-tier men, women, and men.

text: 中国女性感觉的不平等主要是和上层男性比较，而社会普男的性别不平等则是和女性比较。
en: The inequality Chinese women feel is mainly in comparison with top-tier men, whereas the gender inequality felt by ordinary men in society is in comparison with women.

text: 中国上层男性的性资源占有在全世界看来都有点夸张（萝莉岛韩国财阀也就图一乐），合法化更加会扩大这个问题。
en: The sexual resources commanded by China's top-tier men are somewhat exaggerated even by global standards (the Korean chaebols on Lolita Island are merely a bit of fun), and legalisation would only widen this problem.

text: 最后，其实我心底很怀疑中国所谓的“共识”是什么？
en: Finally, deep down I rather doubt what China's so-called “consensus” actually is?

text: 我有一种没有证据的感觉：很多人的共识其实是“法律这么规定”就是对的。
en: I have a feeling with no evidence: many people's consensus is actually that “the law says so” means it is right.

text: 事实上，你根本无法反驳。
en: In fact, you simply cannot rebut it.

text: 你以为的卖淫是，互相不认识，男方给钱，女方躺下，完事儿以后各本东西，今日消费是嫖资+酒店房间钱，取个整数，1000块（嫖资600，酒店400）。
en: What you imagine prostitution to be is this: the two parties do not know each other, the man pays, the woman lies down, and once it is done they each go their separate ways. Today's spending is the prostitution fee plus the hotel room cost, rounded off to 1,000 yuan (600 for the prostitution fee, 400 for the hotel).

text: 但实际上呢？
en: But what is the reality?

text: 社交软件上，男的也不是什么好东西，女的也不老实。
en: On social apps, men aren't exactly good sorts either, and women aren't honest either.

text: 挑个互相喜欢的，有眼缘的，或者叫什么，契合的，就开始如下操作：
en: Pick someone mutually liked, someone you find attractive, or whatever you call it, someone compatible, and begin the following operation:

text: 一起吃饭、看电影、送个小礼物、买杯奶茶.......
en: Eat together, watch a film, give a small gift, buy a cup of milk tea......

text: 如此这般重复个几次，顺理成章的就滚了床单。
en: Repeat this a few times, and naturally they end up in bed together.

text: 其实仔细算算，花费比叫个肯德基还贵呢。
en: Actually, if you do the maths carefully, the cost is even higher than ordering a KFC.

text: 并且最恐怖的是，这种情况已经越来越常态化了。
en: And the most terrifying thing is that this situation has become increasingly normalised.

text: 为啥都是默认女性去卖，男的不可以吗？
en: Why is it always assumed that women do the selling? Can't men?

text: 男娼在我国可是历史悠久啊。
en: Male prostitution has a long history in our country.

text: 你以为你要担心的是妻子子女，说不定要先担心你自己，毕竟这年头什么口味的都有
en: You think you need to worry about your wife and children, but you might need to worry about yourself first; after all, in this day and age there's a taste for everything.

text: 我是支持派，以下问题进行观点阐述：
en: I am on the supporting side; I will set out my views on the following questions:

text: 1、my合法化了，你支持不支持自己家的女眷从事这一行？
en: 1. If prostitution were legalised, would you support the women of your own family entering this trade?

text: 答：行业合法和从事该行业没有必然性；如果面临生存危机的时候，我接受家人从事这一行；相比面对严重职业病危害的岗位，我宁可家人选择my（前提是行业规范）
en: Answer: The legality of an industry and working in that industry are not inevitably linked; if faced with a survival crisis, I would accept my family members entering this trade; compared with jobs that carry serious occupational disease risks, I would rather my family choose prostitution (provided the industry is regulated).

text: 2、my合法化后的人口拐卖和黑社会问题
en: 2. The issues of human trafficking and organised crime after the legalisation of prostitution

text: 答：任何行业都有走捷径的人，搞土方的，挖沙的大家都懂，杜绝行业乱象需要的是充分竞争和有效监管，没有暴利就能减少暴力，一刀切也不是监管。
en: Answer: Every industry has people who take shortcuts; those in earthmoving, those dredging sand — everyone understands. Eliminating industry disorder requires full competition and effective regulation; without huge profits, violence is reduced, and a blanket ban is not regulation either.

text: 3、性病传播和家庭伦理问题
en: 3. The spread of sexually transmitted diseases and issues of family ethics

text: 答：my合法化不是放纵滥交，禁止my既杜绝不了my现象，也控制不住性开放的社会风气，恐性是一种逃避心态，一如以前的生理课进学校，请问，你在还反对青少年生理课堂吗？
en: Answer: Legalising prostitution is not condoning promiscuity; banning prostitution neither eliminates the phenomenon of prostitution nor controls the socially liberal attitude towards sex. Being afraid of sex is a form of avoidance; just like when sex-education lessons entered schools — tell me, do you still oppose physiology classes for teenagers?

text: 至于破坏家庭之说，相比日益降低的结婚率，难到几亿单身人士的性问题还不能摆上台面谈一谈吗？
en: As for the claim that it destroys families, compared with the ever-declining marriage rate, is it not possible to discuss the sexual issues of hundreds of millions of single people openly?

text: 你乎上这些人口口声声是为了给女性自由而支持卖淫合法化，其实说白了是想要嫖娼合法化而已。
en: These people on Zhihu clamour about supporting the legalisation of prostitution for the sake of women's freedom, but in plain terms they just want the legalisation of visiting prostitutes.

text: 比如，如果制定这么条法律，妓女卖淫无罪，但嫖客重罚，想必这些在这里夸夸其谈的群公们又要反对了。
en: For example, if such a law were enacted — prostitutes bear no guilt for prostitution, but clients are heavily punished — surely these people who pontificate here would oppose it again.

text: 关于卖淫合法，其实存在两个方向的辩论角度。
en: Regarding the legalisation of prostitution, there are actually two directions of debate.

text: 一个是客观维度，比如卖淫合法能降低强奸率，这个是可以以数据来进行批驳的，目前没有任何证据表明卖淫合法与降低强奸率之间有任何联系；另一个是主观维度，到了这儿就是无法辩论的了，因为这涉及到一个核心问题，就是人对自己身体的处置权问题。
en: One is the objective dimension — for example, that legalising prostitution can lower the rape rate; this can be refuted with data, and at present there is no evidence whatsoever showing any link between the legalisation of prostitution and a lower rape rate. The other is the subjective dimension, where debate becomes impossible, because it touches on a core issue: a person's right to dispose of their own body.

text: 因为对于卖淫这个事，不同人的态度是不一样的。
en: Because attitudes towards prostitution differ from person to person.

text: 我们要对人类这个物种的多样性有信心——比如，很多人会说，父母怎么会害孩子呢？
en: We must have confidence in the diversity of the human species — for example, many people say, how could parents harm their children?

text: 但你翻翻判决文书，父母虐待孩子乃至卖掉、杀掉孩子的比比皆是。
en: But if you look through the judgement documents, cases of parents abusing their children, even selling or killing them, are everywhere.

text: 这些人难道不是父母么？
en: Aren't these people parents?

text: 而卖淫这事，假如说你非要用“那你的女儿去卖淫你支持么”，万一人家说没问题，那你怎么办呢？
en: As for prostitution, if you insist on using “would you support your daughter going into prostitution”, what if the other person says that's fine — what would you do then?

text: 这样的事情现实中不存在么？
en: Does such a situation not exist in reality?

text: 很多父母其实知道孩子在做什么的，但有些人就是觉得无所谓的，只要能挣来钱就行。
en: Many parents actually know what their children are doing, but some simply don't care, as long as the money comes in.

text: 在任何不是非此即彼的判断上，都存在一个浮动区间。
en: On any judgement that is not a binary either/or, there exists a floating range.

text: 假使我们把这个区间规定为0~100分，有的人的分值在5分，有的在95分。
en: Suppose we define this range as 0–100 points; some people's score is 5, others' is 95.

text: 那么，如果我们把卖淫看作是人以自己身体来牟利的一个方式，那在以身体来牟利的角度上，到底该在什么地方划红线？
en: Then, if we regard prostitution as a way for a person to profit from their own body, from the perspective of profiting from one's body, where exactly should the red line be drawn?

text: 换句话说，如果说同样表演跳舞挣钱，跳普通民族舞、钢管舞、脱衣舞之间是否存在质的差别？
en: In other words, if one earns money by dancing performances, is there a qualitative difference between performing ordinary folk dance, pole dancing, and striptease?

text: 如果说不存在，那么跳脱衣舞的时候，不停地蹭观看者的身子，这算不算变质呢？
en: If one says there is none, then during a striptease, constantly rubbing against the spectators' bodies — does that count as a degradation?

text: 之后，只要一步步滑坡，总会滑到床上去的。
en: After that, as long as one slides step by step, one will always end up sliding into bed.

text: 现实中，有人认为跳舞的底线就是穿着专业的衣服来跳，而有的人觉得穿的暴漏一点，擦个边也没什么。
en: In reality, some think the bottom line for dancing is to perform in professional attire, while others feel that dressing a bit more revealing and skirting the line is no big deal.

text: 这都是个人的选择。
en: These are all personal choices.

text: 而另一方面，在对淫秽信息等的认定上，其实也存在很大的自由裁量权，这也说明对这类事情的判断是存在很大主观性的。
en: On the other hand, in the determination of obscene material and the like, there is actually considerable discretion, which also shows that judgement on such matters is highly subjective.

text: 至于“卖淫”这个概念，概念也一直在浮动。
en: As for the concept of “prostitution” itself, the concept has also been constantly shifting.

text: 比如，最开始的卖淫是限定在插入式性行为上的，后来很多非插入式的性行为也被纳入到了其中。
en: For example, prostitution was originally confined to penetrative sexual acts; later, many non-penetrative sexual acts were also incorporated into it.

text: 那么说，提供非插入式的性服务，算不算卖淫？
en: So, does providing non-penetrative sexual services count as prostitution?

text: 虽然法律上是有规定的，但是去问普通人的话，肯定能得到不同的意见。
en: Although the law has provisions, if you ask ordinary people, you will surely get differing opinions.

text: 再宽泛一点，如果按照美国法律的定义，亲吻、爱抚也可以算性行为的一部分。
en: Taken more broadly, according to the definition under US law, kissing and fondling can also count as part of sexual behaviour.

text: 那收钱提供爱抚可以算卖淫么？
en: Then does providing fondling for money count as prostitution?

text: 正是因为这个差异的存在，那么对于卖淫合法与否的讨论，其实就必然回归到客观层面。
en: Precisely because this difference exists, the discussion of whether prostitution should be legalised inevitably returns to the objective level.

text: 但就像开头所说，回到客观层面，那就要拿证据。
en: But as said at the beginning, returning to the objective level means producing evidence.

text: 卖淫是否合法与强奸率之间的关系得不到任何证实，而对于所谓卖淫合法化后的秩序想象，在现实中也站不住脚——因为即便不看大清、民国，在今天的欧美，组织卖淫也是人口贩卖最主要的目的之一。
en: The relationship between the legality of prostitution and the rape rate cannot be confirmed at all, and the imagined order after the legalisation of prostitution also fails to hold up in reality — because even setting aside the Qing dynasty and the Republic of China, in today's Europe and America, organising prostitution is one of the principal purposes of human trafficking.

text: 这方面也可以直接用数据说话。
en: On this point one can also let the data speak directly.

text: 欧盟2013年发布的数据显示，在2008年至2010年间，欧盟国家人口贩卖人数增加了18%，其中61%的受害者来自欧盟国家，主要来自罗马尼亚和保加利亚。
en: Data released by the EU in 2013 shows that between 2008 and 2010, the number of human-trafficking victims in EU countries rose by 18%, of whom 61% came from EU countries, mainly Romania and Bulgaria.

text: 在受害者中，成年女性占多数，达到68%，未成年女性达12%，男性受害者人数占比增加，达到17%，男性未成年人占3%。
en: Among the victims, adult women were in the majority at 68%, underage females reached 12%, the proportion of male victims rose to 17%, and male minors accounted for 3%.

text: 联合国国际劳工组织去年发布的统计数据显示，2013年全球共有2000多万人成为人口贩卖和强迫劳工的受害者，犯罪团伙通过这种犯罪获利丰厚。
en: Statistics released last year by the International Labour Organisation of the United Nations show that in 2013, more than 20 million people worldwide became victims of human trafficking and forced labour, with criminal gangs profiting handsomely from this crime.

text: 犯罪团伙通过贩卖人口所获收益中，有三分之二来自强迫卖淫，其他则来自强迫劳工。
en: Of the proceeds criminal gangs obtained through human trafficking, two-thirds came from forced prostitution, and the rest from forced labour.

text: 贩卖人口中，主要以女性居多，但也有相当一部分儿童和男性。
en: Among those trafficked, women were the majority, but there was also a considerable proportion of children and men.

text: 在这里我引用的只是数据，没有涉及任何个案或者主观性的评价。
en: Here I have cited only data, without touching on any individual cases or subjective evaluation.

text: 欧盟已经是全球经济最发达的地区之一，但在卖淫合法化的趋势下，从区域内穷国向富国的人口贩卖依然无法断绝。
en: The EU is already one of the world's most economically developed regions, yet under the trend of legalising prostitution, human trafficking from poorer to richer countries within the region still cannot be cut off.

text: 那么，所谓“如果合法，自愿卖淫的竞争上岗，不漂亮的可能还不要，供大于求，而且拿牌营业，也不存在逼迫的情况”的依据，又来自哪里呢？
en: Then, where does the so-called basis come from that “if it were legal, voluntary prostitutes would compete for positions, the less attractive might even be rejected, supply would exceed demand, and with licensed operation there would be no coercion”?

text: 另一方面，即便卖淫是自愿的，这种自愿就真的那么“自愿”么？
en: On the other hand, even if prostitution is voluntary, is this “voluntary” really so voluntary?

text: 假如你是一个卖淫组织的负责人，在15岁、25岁和35岁的人之间，你会选择谁来营业？
en: If you were the person in charge of a prostitution organisation, between a 15-year-old, a 25-year-old and a 35-year-old, who would you choose to work?

text: 毫无疑问，15岁的人不仅“营业周期”更长，而且因为年轻，也会更受“消费者”的喜欢。
en: Without doubt, the 15-year-old not only has a longer “working lifespan”, but being young is also more favoured by the “consumers”.

text: 可未成年人的心智本就不成熟，很容易上当受骗。
en: Yet minors are inherently immature and easily deceived.

text: 你想拉一个35岁的人下水，得付出极高的成本，人家还不一定愿意。
en: To drag a 35-year-old into this, you would have to pay an extremely high cost, and they might not even be willing.

text: 但是对十几岁的孩子，那就太容易了。
en: But with a teenager, it is all too easy.

text: 十几岁的孩子，正是消费欲望最强却也最穷的时候。
en: Teenagers are precisely at the age when their desire to consume is strongest yet they are the poorest.

text: 我上大学的时候，曾经非常想要一部iPhone和一台Macbook。
en: When I was at university, I very much wanted an iPhone and a MacBook.

text: 如今，虽然iPhone、Macbook这些我都有了，但我现在反倒觉得有没有无所谓。
en: Now, although I have an iPhone, a MacBook and so on, I actually feel it doesn't matter whether I have them or not.

text: 如果说这些东西坏了，你让我换个千元机和普通的三四千的笔记本来用，我也不觉得会有落差，因为的确也够用。
en: If these things broke and you asked me to switch to a thousand-yuan phone and an ordinary three- or four-thousand-yuan laptop, I wouldn't feel any gap either, because they really are good enough.

text: 在一个人消费欲望最强却又缺钱的时候，是很容易下手的。
en: When a person's desire to consume is strongest yet they are short of money, it is very easy to make a move on them.

text: 虽然不能说所有的未成年人都是被诱骗卖淫的，但这里面的比例肯定不会低。
en: Although one cannot say that all minors are lured into prostitution, the proportion among them is certainly not low.

text: 而且，很多卖淫合法的国家，赌博、毒品的管制也很宽松。
en: Moreover, in many countries where prostitution is legal, the control of gambling and drugs is also very lax.

text: 最简单的方式，找几个人引诱未成年人吸毒，然后等到钱花完了，就给她介绍卖淫的去处——为啥不去干正经工作？
en: The simplest method: get a few people to lure a minor into taking drugs, then, once the money runs out, introduce her to prostitution — why not go and do an honest job?

text: 有几个正经工作能撑得起吸毒的？
en: How many honest jobs can sustain a drug habit?

text: 当然，你可以说这个人从吸毒到卖淫全都是她自愿的。
en: Of course, you could say that from taking drugs to prostitution, this person did it all voluntarily.

text: 你问她是不是自愿卖淫，有没有人不让她出门，她也肯定会说是自愿的。
en: If you ask her whether she is a voluntary prostitute, whether anyone stops her from going out, she will certainly say she is voluntary.

text: 但稍有点良心的话，你真能说她是“自愿”的？
en: But if you have even a shred of conscience, can you really say she is “voluntary”?

text: 那种理想化的卖淫合法带来的“秩序”，从古至今都不存在。
en: That idealised “order” brought by the legalisation of prostitution has never existed, from ancient times to the present.

text: 当然，因为卖淫交易本身的私密性，决定了其无论如何打击，都不可能禁绝。
en: Of course, the private nature of prostitution transactions themselves means that, however vigorously it is cracked down on, it can never be completely eradicated.

text: 而且，卖淫也不都是零售，也有批发的形式，而批发基本是不受法律管辖的。
en: Moreover, prostitution is not all retail; there is also a wholesale form, and wholesale is essentially not subject to the law's jurisdiction.

text: 但总的来说，对卖淫合法与否的讨论，核心是“公益”与秩序问题。
en: But overall, the discussion of whether prostitution should be legalised centres on the issue of “public good” and order.

text: 卖淫在一个国家的合法化程度，也受一个群体共识的影响。
en: The degree of legalisation of prostitution in a country is also influenced by group consensus.

text: 这才是卖淫合法化问题争论的真正焦点。
en: This is the true focus of the debate over the legalisation of prostitution.

text: 从主观上，任何一个人都可以对卖淫是否应该合法有自己的判断，但在客观上以规范秩序、降低强奸罪等为理由的任何论点，都纯属没有任何数据和事例支撑的臆想。
en: Subjectively, anyone may have their own judgement on whether prostitution should be legal; but objectively, any argument made on grounds such as regulating order or lowering the rape rate is pure conjecture with no data or cases to support it.

text: 真要是想为卖淫合法化说句话，倒不如干脆直接从经济和就业角度来说——毕竟，作为产业的卖淫再怎么不好，带来的GDP和税收倒是实实在在的。
en: If you really want to say a word in favour of legalising prostitution, you might as well speak directly from the angle of the economy and employment — after all, however bad prostitution as an industry may be, the GDP and tax revenue it brings are real and tangible.

text: 不然，这种臆想出来的“合法化”，也不过是另一种形式的地上天国。
en: Otherwise, this imagined “legalisation” is merely another form of a heaven on earth.
